forced_form_diagnosis.defect: Held items with forced_forme are applied without checking the native base species. A normal Mew holding Flame Plate or Fire Memory becomes Arceus-Fire or Silvally-Fire in battle and receives that form's native ability.
forced_form_diagnosis.root_cause: Battle._apply_item_forme_effects unconditionally calls formeChange for Item.forced_forme. Pokemon.formeChange installs the requested form, calculated stats/types and its default ability. The native-species and ability eligibility gates are missing.
forced_form_diagnosis.original_control_diagnosis: The No Ability native controls cannot isolate these abilities because entry form change reinstates the native ability before observation. They are invalid controls; their exact original failures must remain visible.
forced_form_diagnosis.coverage_scope: Normal native activation observed against native same-ability/no-item controls; the two foreign-holder eligibility failures remain open. No claim of an ability-only comparison for these two abilities.

recycle_diagnosis.diagnosis: The 20%-HP fixture ate its restored Oran Berry again while still below half HP. Recycle healed another 10 HP correctly; expecting a held berry at the final checkpoint was invalid.
recycle_diagnosis.corrected_fixture: Start at 49% canonical maximum HP: entry consumes the original berry and raises HP above half; the recycled berry remains held.

recycle_diagnosis.diagnostic_runner_correction: The first control audit looked for the word failed; retained output correctly says Recycle on itself but it had no effect. The assertion was corrected against the same unchanged recorded commands and state.

mycelium_diagnosis.diagnosis: The final paralysis assertion ignored Limber onUpdate curing paralysis after the bypassed status application. The existing local Showdown simulator gives the same cured final state. A native Good as Gold target proves a persistent status-bypass effect with an ability-only matched control.

remaining_verification_and_work: Fix the forced_forme native-species eligibility gate, then rerun all affected plate power checks, wrong-holder item negatives, and Multitype/RKS System controls.
The reusable Recycle fixture and Mycelium Might endpoint expectation still need their task-local corrections incorporated into durable runner definitions.
Declared scenarios and observed branches do not establish every combined interaction, natural learnset, progression route or activation rate.
